name: The Quick Draw McGraw Show
description: The Quick Draw McGraw Show is the third cartoon television production created by Hanna-Barbera, starring an anthropomorphic cartoon horse named Quick Draw McGraw. The series featured 3 cartoons per episode, one each by Quick Draw McGraw & Baba Looey, father and son dog duo Augie Doggie & Doggie Daddy, and cat and mouse detectives Snooper & Blabber.

videos.title: Scary Prairie
videos.overview: In the Wild and Woolly West, there are numerous rewards for devious villains, and Quick Draw goes after the $5,000 reward for the capture of the well known pole cat, Grumble-Weed, who just robbed the bank.

videos.title: Fox Hound Hounded Fox
videos.overview: Tired of getting small toy foxes for his birthday every year, Doggie Daddy allows Augie to go into the woods for a real one.

videos.title: Puss N' Booty
videos.overview: In the pilot episode, Snooper and Blabber try to protect the penniless heir Alowishus from his disinherited butler and a man impersonating him.

videos.title: Bad Guys Disguise
videos.overview: Quick Draw and his sidekick Baba Looey travel to Bad Guys Territory where the Bad Guys are welcome and the Good Guys are unwelcome. There they try to blend in with the bad guys by wearing a disguise.

videos.title: Augie the Watchdog
videos.overview: Augie is permitted by his father to guard their home for one night.

videos.title: Switch Witch
videos.overview: In court, Snooper and Blabber testify in the trial of a witch accused of persecuting Hansel and Gretel.

videos.title: Scat, Scout, Scat
videos.overview: Quick Draw and his sidekick Baba Looey hold off Big Chief Little Runt so that the railroad station can be built and continue out west. Trail-blazing Quick Draw, spearheading the railroad's western invasion, and Baba Looey have trouble with iron horse-hating Little Runt and his braves. Little Runt and Quick Draw battle to establish a right-of-way. Finally, peace is made, with Little Runt winning the blanket sales concession.

videos.title: Skunk You Very Much
videos.overview: Augie befriends a skunk, much to his father's dislike.

videos.title: Real Gone Ghosts
videos.overview: The Captain of a ship summons Snooper and Blabber to take care of a couple of poltergeists.

videos.title: Choo-Choo Chumps
videos.overview: The coming of the Railroads gave the outlaws of the west, new fields in which to ply their nefarious trade, so the Slinkerton Detective Agency hired the dreaded nemesis of all outlaws, Quick Draw McGraw to enforce justice.

videos.title: In the Picnic of Time
videos.overview: An ant takes a beating from Doggie Daddy, then decides to assemble some troops to get back at him.

videos.title: Desperate Diamond Dimwits
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber attempt to retrieve the King-Size diamond stolen by the thief Lightfingers.

videos.title: Masking For Trouble
videos.overview: Sundown Sam wants to marry Sagebrush Sally but she refuses, and Quick Draw and Baba Looey come to the rescue of Sally the heroin but she's fickle and turns on them.

videos.title: High & Flighty
videos.overview: Augie comes up with a flying saucer and heads into orbit.

videos.title: Big Diaper Caper
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber go to the Evil Scientist residence to babysit a sinister baby.

videos.title: Lamb Chopped
videos.overview: Quick Draw and his sidekick Baba Looey are offered $5,000 to stop Snagglepuss the mountain lion from stealing sheep.

videos.title: Nag! Nag! Nag!
videos.overview: Augie wants to keep a horse at home but his father is reluctant.

videos.title: The Flea and Me
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber search for a missing stage star flea named Rudolf, who proves to be slippery for the detectives.

videos.title: Double Barrel Double
videos.overview: Quick Draw meets his look-alike twin, Horse-Faced Harry.

videos.title: Good Mouse Keeping
videos.overview: The duo tries to get rid of an annoying mouse from their home.

videos.title: Disappearing Inc.
videos.overview: A crook gets hold of an invisibility formula. To catch him, Snooper has Blabber take some of the formula.

videos.title: Riverboat Shuffled
videos.overview: Quick Draw poses as a wealthy gentleman on a Mississippi boat to look for a man.

videos.title: Tee Vee or Not Tee Vee
videos.overview: A neighborhood child challenges Augie if his father ever starred on television. Doggie Daddy goes for it.

videos.title: Baby Rattled
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber are assigned to guard a safe in a mansion. But when Babypants infiltrates, a cop stands in the detectives' way.

videos.title: Dizzy Desperado
videos.overview: Baba Looey gets amnesia and thinks he is a mean bank robber.

videos.title: Big Top Pop
videos.overview: Augie decides to live a life in the circus. His father then follows.

videos.title: Not So Dummy
videos.overview: In Goony Island, Snooper and Blabber investigate a robbery caused by Babypants disguised as a dummy.

videos.title: Sagebrush Brush
videos.overview: In the old west for relaxation, a card game of chance was an easy place to cheat, so to combat the lawless element that ran unchecked throughout the west, Quick Draw and Baba Looey stepped in to restore law and order.

videos.title: Million Dollar Robbery
videos.overview: Augie steals a sack of cash from a bank to pay his father's bills, or so Doggie Daddy thinks.

videos.title: Masquerader Raider
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber go to the Grumbles Department Store to catch Quick Change Quentin disguising himself as various people.

videos.title: El Kabong
videos.overview: Quick Draw makes up a Zorro-like hero- El Kabong.

videos.title: Talk It Up Pup
videos.overview: For unknown reasons, Augie won't speak to his father.

videos.title: Slippery Glass Slipper
videos.overview: Blabber tells a journalist all about his and Snooper's royal case finding the lady who owns a glass slipper.

videos.title: El Kabong Strikes Again
videos.overview: El Kabong returns to battle the Terrible Tabasco to save a señorita.

videos.title: Pup Plays Pop
videos.overview: Augie Doggie and Doggie Daddy exchange roles.

videos.title: Motor Knows Best
videos.overview: Snooper volunteers to beat Crash Smithereens in a car race, while avoiding his cheating tricks.

videos.title: Slick City Slicker
videos.overview: Notorious bandit The Raindrop Kid checks into the fancy Bella Crystal Hotel in San Francisco, posing as a millionaire. Fortunately, Quick Draw McGraw is on his trail, pretending to be a hayseed staying in the same hotel.

videos.title: Crow Cronies
videos.overview: A sly crow tricks the duo to providing him hospitality.

videos.title: Fee Fi Fo Fumble
videos.overview: With the hope of earning the Pussyfoot award, Snooper explains his case about a vanished bank and a giant.

videos.title: Doggone Prairie Dog
videos.overview: Quick Draw and Baba Looey go out in the desert to look for a hungry prairie dog.

videos.title: Pop's Nature Pup
videos.overview: Augie and his father go camping.

videos.title: Gopher Goofers
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber are assigned to remove a pesky gopher from a rich garden. Their every attempt fails.

videos.title: Bow-Wow Bandit
videos.overview: Quick Draw gets Snuffles to help him get Baba Looey out of jail.

videos.title: Cat Happy Pappy
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy teaches his son how to deal with a vicious cat.

videos.title: Cloudy Rowdy
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber follow the trail of Nimbo Nimbus in his giant skycloud after he steals a precious sapphire.

videos.title: Cattle Battle Rattled
videos.overview: At the turn of the century, there was a great demand for beef and the cattle drive was started, so Quick Draw, Baba Looey and Snuffles were sent out to fight off rustlers.

videos.title: Whatever Goes Pup
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy drinks a potion made by his son and starts to become airborne.

videos.title: Monkey Wrenched
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber go to a supermarket to catch an escaped monkey while trying to keep quiet about it.

videos.title: Gun Gone Goons
videos.overview: Quick Draw poses as a out-of-towner in a bar to find a bad guy. Quick Draw is summoned from retirement by the clamor of an outraged citizenry repeatedly bilked of their savings by Slippery Earl Slick. Poor McGraw cannot cope with Slick until McGraw's partner, Baba Looey, hides in the con man's valise and subdues him.

videos.title: Pipsqueak Pop
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy applies another potion made by his son and shrinks.

videos.title: Adventure is My Hobby
videos.overview: Snooper, starring on television, explains a case at Lake Wacha Macha Pool where a sea monster dwelled.

videos.title: Six-Gun Spook
videos.overview: Baba Looey introduces the viewer to flashback sequences about the lifelong feud between Quick Draw McGraw and Little Varmint. Our heroes plan to capture Little Varmint by luring him with his favorite prize - a lollipop.

videos.title: Fan Clubbed
videos.overview: Because Augie's favorite hero wouldn't show up on his birthday, Doggie Daddy, in disguise, takes charge.

videos.title: Impossible Imposters
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber track a mad scientist who has created robot clones of Snooper to give him a criminal name.

videos.title: Treasure of El Kabong
videos.overview: Quick Draw McGraw agrees to save the mayor's daughter. She is held for ransom by buccaneer Walker De Plank, who is coming ashore to pillage the local village. Quick Draw comes to the rescue as his swashbuckling alter ego, El Kabong!

videos.title: Ro-Butler
videos.overview: Augie invents a robot to be a servant to the household.

videos.title: Snap Happy Saps
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber go to the Evil Scientist residence to take a photo of Junior.

videos.title: Locomotive Loco
videos.overview: Quick Draw McGraw and Baba Looey tries to bring back a golden spike from a outlaw.

videos.title: Gone to the Ducks
videos.overview: An orphaned duck wishes to join the family.

videos.title: The Lion Is Busy
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber search for the escaped mountain lion Snagglepuss, and all three get tangled in the Adventurers' Club.

videos.title: Bronco Bustin' Boobs
videos.overview: Mild Bill calls upon the services of Quick Draw McGraw and Baba Looey to bring in a full-grown midget wild horse to perform in the ring at Mild Bill's Wild West Show. Quick Draw uses Snuffles to bring him back.

videos.title: Mars's Little Precious
videos.overview: A baby alien is sent to be baby-sat by Augie.

videos.title: Laughing Guess
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber try to make Hardy Har Har laugh. Only slipping on a banana peel will make the hyena laugh.

videos.title: The Lyin' Lion
videos.overview: Snagglepuss reads in the paper that sheep are at the county fair, so he proceeds over to snag some, but Quick Draw and Baba Looey are there to stop him.

videos.title: Swats the Matter
videos.overview: Three mosquitoes infiltrate the duo's home.

videos.title: The Case of the Purloined Parrot
videos.overview: Snooper tells how Captain Scuttle's parrot was snatched, since he knew where to find a lost treasure chest.

videos.title: Chopping Spree
videos.overview: Welcome to the Roaring Splinter Lumber Camp, the toughest part in the old northwest, where a man's measure was tested by the ability to "taketh", and the squeamish were squashed. Peachy Blossom is the lumber queen who runs the mill and seeks help from Quick Draw to solve the mysterious problems at the camp.

videos.title: Snagglepuss
videos.overview: Augie adopts a run-away circus lion.

videos.title: Poodle Toodle-Oo!
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber, with the help of Toot Sweet the flea, try to track down a runaway poodle. They abort their mission when they see she has a fiance.

videos.title: Elephant Boy Oh Boy!
videos.overview: In the days of the old west, all gun fights came to an end when the Traveling show came to town, and amongst the animals an elephant becomes fond of Quick Draw.

videos.title: Hum Sweet Hum
videos.overview: A wiley alley cat tries to get Augie's trained hummingbird before his "big TV appearance".

videos.title: Doggone Dog, Gone!
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber seek a lost diamond ring. The chase it until Blabber accidentally swallows it.

videos.title: Bull-Leave Me
videos.overview: Quick Draw volunteers to find and get rid of a smart-aleck bull.

videos.title: Peck O' Trouble
videos.overview: A nutty woodpecker insists on staying at Augie's house, despite Doggie Daddy's objections.

videos.title: Hula-Hula Hullabaloo
videos.overview: Snooper is to deliver a ping pong pearl to San Francisco, but it gets eaten by a flying fish.

videos.title: Kabong Kabong's Kabong
videos.overview: Horseface Harry disguises himself as El Kabong to rob banks, so Quick Draw and Baba Looey must stop the impostor.

videos.title: Fuss & Feathers
videos.overview: An ostrich hatches from an egg that rolls into the Doggie hen house and Augie decides to adopt it.

videos.title: Wild Man, Wild!
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber tail a wild man on the loose. By the time they find him, he's become civilized and adopted.

videos.title: El Kabong Meets El Kazing
videos.overview: In the old west fighting between cattle and sheep herder went on for years until they ran out of bullets then they had to watch out for Snagglepuss the stealing lion. So the sheriff sends for El Kabong.

videos.title: Yuk-Yuk Duck
videos.overview: The orphaned duck pays them a visit to their home.

videos.title: Ala-Kazoop!
videos.overview: Snooper and an inspector are on the case of a stolen ruby. Blabber possessed by Hypno's powers is after that ruby.

videos.title: Bullet Proof Galoot
videos.overview: Quick Draw and his sidekick Baba Looey go up against Fast-Gun Finnegan.

videos.title: It's a Mice Day
videos.overview: Augie tries to cure his friend, a sick mouse, but a cat is on the loose and is eventually shrunk by Augie with his shrinking chemical.

videos.title: Hop to It
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber chase after a diamond thief hitching a ride in a kangaroo's pouch, who repeatedly stomps on Snooper.

videos.title: Two Too Much
videos.overview: Quick Draw meets his look-alike Horseface Harry again.

videos.title: Bud Brothers
videos.overview: Augie creates a voracious plant that starts eating all the food.

videos.title: Fleas Be Careful
videos.overview: Blabber tells all about Snooper's case regarding Toot Sweet trying win the heart of his girlfriend, who was taken by a slick flea.

videos.title: Twin Troubles
videos.overview: Quick Draw goes to court about two twins. One of them poses as a mother and one poses as a son.

videos.title: Pint Giant
videos.overview: While Augie tries to find a giant that only exists in a fable, his father attempts to make it a reality through disguise.

videos.title: Observant Servants
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber go undercover to guard a precious tiara, which gets taken by Lightfingers, hiding in a birthday cake.

videos.title: Ali-Baba Looey
videos.overview: The Slinkerton Detective Agency sends for Quick Draw McGraw and Baba Looey to catch the Shadow Bandit, and they use Snuffles to catch him.

videos.title: It's a Worm Day
videos.overview: Fearing that he might lose his worth as a father, Doggie Daddy attempts to eliminate a bookworm from the library.

videos.title: De-Duck-Tives
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber are sent to hunt a Tralfazian duck, but a duckling pesters them thinking their duck decoy is his mother.

videos.title: Shooting Room Only
videos.overview: Quick Draw poses as a out-of-towner and mixes with a dangerous theater robber, Box Office Smash.

videos.title: Patient Pop
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy acts as a sick patient to play along with his son, but a cat bothers patient Doggie Daddy.

videos.title: Big Shot Blab
videos.overview: Blabber eats a peanut which is a high atomic explosive entrusted to Snooper by a scientist. Then he gives Snooper a hard time.

videos.title: Yippee Coyote
videos.overview: While traveling to California guiding wagons, Wagon Masters Quick Draw and Baba Looey encounters a sly coyote.

videos.title: Let's Duck Out
videos.overview: While the duo are having a winter trip, they are greeted again by the orphaned duck.

videos.title: Big Cat Caper
videos.overview: Before Snooper can send Snagglepuss to the zoo, he escapes. Snooper and Blabber chase the mountain lion through the city park.

videos.title: Gun Shy Gal
videos.overview: The west was wild with a bunch of outlaws, but no one was more dangerous than Texas Tillie, and only Quick Draw McGraw and Baba Looey are brave enough to go after her.

videos.title: The Party Lion
videos.overview: A lion (Snagglepuss) escapes from the zoo and acts as a rug in the two dogs' home.

videos.title: Scoop Snoop
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber travel to the Himalayas to photograph an Abominable Snowman. Blabber gets successful photo shots.

videos.title: Who Is El Kabong?
videos.overview: A bad guy tries to find out who El Kabong is and Quick Draw McGraw tries to prove to the bad guy that he is the real El Kabong.

videos.title: The Musket-Tears
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy makes up stories about him being one of the musketeers just to impress his child.

videos.title: Prince of a Fella's
videos.overview: The Wickedonia Queen sends Snooper and Blabber to find Snow White. Instead, they have her meet Prince Charming and turn into frogs.

videos.title: Scooter Rabbit
videos.overview: Quick Draw and Baba Looey are hired from the Mayor to get rid of a pesty rabbit, but they need help from Snuffles the Dog to catch him.

videos.title: Horse Fathers
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy receives a horse for his birthday from Augie.

videos.title: Flea for All
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber follow a diamond theft to Scratchit's flea circus. Snooper then gets Toot Sweet to infiltrate the flea circus.

videos.title: Talky Hawky
videos.overview: During the Gold Rush, the greedy rushers forgot about food, which became a high commodity, and Quick Draw McGraw is brought in to protect the chicken ranch to protect eggs from a poacher.

videos.title: Playmate Pup
videos.overview: Augie makes up an imaginary friend.

videos.title: Eenie Genie Minie Mo
videos.overview: Blabber goes with Snooper to recover Aladdin's genie. A long chase eventually gets the genie caught.

videos.title: Extra-Special Extra!
videos.overview: Quick Draw protects a newspaper publisher from an outlaw who doesn't like the bad press.

videos.title: Little Wonder
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy plans to make a real genius out of his son.

videos.title: Bear-ly Able
videos.overview: The Bear Family request Snooper and Blabber to find the thief who stole their porridge, who is none other than the Big Bad Wolf.

videos.title: El Kabong, Jr.
videos.overview: An aging Quick Draw's son visits him and steps in for him to battle real estate agent Toothy Acres.

videos.title: Treasure Jest
videos.overview: Augie and a British parrot go treasure hunting.

videos.title: Surprised Party
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber go to the Evil Scientist residence to hold a party for their baby, who puts them into a lot of danger.

videos.title: El Kabong Was Wrong
videos.overview: This is the story of Cactus Cecil who was determined to rob a bank in the old west, and he uses El Kabong to make it happen.

videos.title: Dough Nutty
videos.overview: Augie gets his hands on a money-counterfeiting machine. The owner attempts to get it back from him. Augie puts on a circus act for a request by the owner so he can get the money since Augie hid it.

videos.title: Chilly Chiller
videos.overview: A ghost requests Snooper and Blabber to remove the Evil Scientist family from his house, but their attempts fail.

videos.title: Dynamite Fright
videos.overview: Quick Draw, Baba Looey and Snuffles track down a short outlaw who plans to blow up the new dam.

videos.title: Growing, Growing Gone
videos.overview: Augie starts to go on a journey on his own to prove to his dad that he's grown up.

videos.title: Outer Space Case
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber are taken to Mars to catch a thieving astronaut monkey. The case ends with Blabber staying behind.

videos.title: Baba Bait
videos.overview: Quick Draw and Baba Looey goes to a small town that is in peril because of a robber called "The Masked Mosquito" and Quick Draw uses Baba Looey as bait to find "The Masked Mosquito."

videos.title: From Ape to Z
videos.overview: Augie befriends a gorilla and tries to keep it indoors.

videos.title: Zoom Zoom Blabber
videos.overview: The Captain Zoom-Zoom actor asks Snooper to catch Fly Burglar. Blabber assumes Zoom-Zoom's identity to protect a precious sapphire.

videos.title: Big Town El Kabong
videos.overview: Quick Draw and Baba Looey go to the city to track down a thief. El Kabong and the thief get into a sword fight.

videos.title: Hand to Mouse
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy wants Bigelow Mouse to leave the house, but he refuses.

videos.title: Bronco Bluster
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber try to find a wild runaway horse. Snooper sends him home to Texas instead of Madison Round Garden.

videos.title: Mine Your Manners
videos.overview: Quick Draw employs Snuffles to get a skunk out of a mine.

videos.title: Party Popper Pop
videos.overview: Doggie Daddy gives pointers to Augie on how to impress the guests at the party next door.

videos.title: Gem Jams
videos.overview: Snooper and Blabber try to find Mr. Richley's stolen gems. The butler is the prime suspect, who used shrinking potion to swipe them.

videos.title: The Mark of El Kabong
videos.overview: El Kabong has a showdown with Generale Badguyos.

videos.title: Vacation Tripped
videos.overview: Augie and Doggie Daddy goes on a hunting trip to Mars, encountering a wacky Martian "rabbit".

videos.title: Person to Prison
videos.overview: In the series finale, Snooper and Blabber go to Sing Song prison disguised as convicts to prevent a jail break. Their attempt only gets them convicted.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 nomination total
